segments.text: My mom has scolded me many times in my life.
segments.acting_note: Casual open hand gesture, direct eye contact with viewer, slight head tilt.

segments.text: Most of them were completely unfair.
segments.acting_note: Subtle defensive shrug, one eyebrow cocked.

segments.text: ...Except this one. This one was entirely deserved.
segments.acting_note: Leans close toward camera, deadpan eye contact, gavel stamp doodle hits with dull thud.

segments.text: Mom left the house around ten in the morning with one simple rule.
segments.acting_note: Pointing outward toward doorway cutaway; Mom gives the classic parent departure gaze.

segments.text: Take the chicken out of the freezer at two PM so it can defrost for dinner.
segments.acting_note: Reading invisible sticky note; doodle sticky note pops up with clean ink lines.

segments.text: Now, two PM was four hours away. That is basically infinite time.
segments.acting_note: Both hands gesturing broad horizon, smug confident smile.

segments.text: I told myself: I have full control over this situation.
segments.acting_note: Puffed chest, hands on hips, sparkling stars glinting in emerald eyes.

segments.text: At one fifty-five, I sat down at my tablet to fix just one single animation line.
segments.acting_note: Stylus tapping rapidly on tablet, hyperfocus gaze, brow furrowed.

segments.text: I blinked twice... and suddenly it was five forty-five.
segments.acting_note: Fast double-blink; clock doodle hands spin into a blur with smoking gears.

segments.text: And that was the exact moment I heard gravel crunch in the driveway.
segments.acting_note: Head snaps sharply left toward window, eyes wide as saucers, shock rays burst.

segments.text: Followed by the car door slamming shut.
segments.acting_note: Total deadpan freeze. Mouth locks into horizontal dash. Zero movement for 1.4s.

segments.text: I sprinted to the freezer. The chicken was not defrosting.
segments.acting_note: Rushing forward, pointing with tremble at frozen rock block.

segments.text: It was an indestructible block of Arctic permafrost.
segments.acting_note: Knocks on chicken block with knuckles; ice crystals doodle shivers.

segments.text: You could have built a house out of this poultry.
segments.acting_note: Hands spread wide, exasperated head shake, sweat drop rolling down temple.

segments.text: I initiated emergency defrost protocol. Hot water bath: complete failure.
segments.acting_note: Frantic hand gestures, counting off failed attempts on fingers.

segments.text: Microwave defrost turned one corner into rubber while the center stayed ice.
segments.acting_note: Inspecting plate in disgust, waving hand away from rubber chicken doodle.

segments.text: So naturally... I grabbed my hairdryer and put it on maximum heat.
segments.acting_note: Brandishing hairdryer like a laser blaster; orange heat lines blasting the frozen block.

segments.text: Right as the hairdryer hit maximum blast... the kitchen door swung open.
segments.acting_note: Hairdryer humming stops; Nemi's eyes dart slowly to doorway; Mom appears in doorway.

segments.text: My mom stood there. Just looking at me.
segments.acting_note: Mom raises single eyebrow in silence; radar circles lock on Nemi; absolute silence for 1.2s.

segments.text: Then she said: 'You have a college degree, and you are blow-drying raw meat.'
segments.acting_note: Mom delivers line with calm devastating deadpan; scolding finger wags once; Nemi slumps.

segments.text: I didn't even try to defend myself. There was zero scientific rebuttal.
segments.acting_note: Palms out in complete surrender, sheepish embarrassed smile with pink cheek blush.

segments.text: We ate cold cereal for dinner in complete silence.
segments.acting_note: Taking a spoonful of doodled cereal, chewing in deadpan contemplation.

segments.text: And I have officially been banned from the freezer.
segments.acting_note: Looks straight into camera lens, tiny affirmative nod, holding quiet stillness into gentle fade.
